sources.snippet: rag-chunker models ONNX models that rag-chunker downloads on first use for local page layout analysis, OCR and table structure recognition. They are unmodified exports of PaddleOCR / PP-StructureV3 models (Apache-2.0); this repository only keeps them at a stable address with their checksums, so the tool keeps working whatever happens to the original mirrors.

sources.snippet: Welcome to rag-chunker Discussions! 👋 Welcome to the rag-chunker Community! rag-chunker is a high-performance, open-source PDF-to-RAG pipeline. By combining the precision of Mistral OCR 3 with a deterministic AST chunker, we aim to provide developer-first tools for building high-fidelity retrieval systems.
